issues.detail: The Greek 'κατακυριευσας αυτων' (having taken control/dominion over them) and 'ισχυσεν κατ αυτους' (exercised power against them) are condensed into 'thắng được hai người trong bọn' (won over two people in the group). The Vietnamese specifies a number ('hai người' - two people) that is not present in the Greek text.

The Greek 'ισχυσεν κατ αυτους' means he exercised power/strength against them, while the Vietnamese 'hành hạ dữ lắm' (tortured/harassed very much) adds a specific intensity and type of action not explicitly stated in the Greek verb.
